question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

a _ z b _ y c _ x _ a z _ b y c c _ a a _ b b _ c c x _ a z _ b y _ c x
solution:
Given : a _ z b _ y c _ x _ a z _ b y c c _ a a _ b b _ c c x _ a z _ b y _ c x

By checking options :

Option 1) bacabzxyabc → a __b__ z b __a__ y c __c__ x __a__ a z __b__ b y c c __z__ a a **__x__** b b __y__ c c x __a__ a z __b__ b y __c__ c x → (It doesn't Follow the pattern) 

Option 2) bacazbxyacb → a __b__ z b __a__ y c __c__ x __a__ a z __z__ b y c c __b__ a a **__x__** b b __y__ c c x __a__ a z __c__ b y __b__ c x → (It doesn't Follow the pattern)

Option 3) acbacxzyabc → a __a__ z b __c__ y c __b__ x __a__ a z __c__ b y c c __x__ a a __z__ b b __y__ c c x __a__ a z __b__ b y __c__ c x → (It doesn't Follow the pattern)

Option 4) abcabxzyabc → a __**a**__ z b __**b**__ y c __**c**__ x __**a**__ a z __**b**__ b y c c __**x**__ a a __**z**__ b b __**y**__ c c x __**a**__ a z __**b**__ b y __**c**__ c x → (It follows the pattern of: aazbbyccx - aazbbyccx - aazbbyccx - aazbbyccx)

So, out of all the options "Option - (4)" follows the pattern.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
